response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), results AS (SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_ownership_gap, AVG(avg_ownership_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_averages) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_ownership_gap, avg_ownership_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_event_average FROM results WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
